text: Figure 9.21: Process Jump to Bootloader Above sequence diagram shows processing of a jump to bootloader on reception of DiagnosticSessionControl. On reception of DiagnosticSessionControl, the Dcm checks if the requested session is configured to trigger a jump to bootloader. In positive case, the Dcm start the jump to bootloader process: • T ransmission of NRC 0x78 (ResponsePending) • On confirmation of transmission of NRC 0x78, the Dcm calls the callout DcmSet- ProgConditions to store all information needed for the bootloader
